sources.title: Adversarial Misuse of Generative AI
sources.analyst_notes: GTIG observed APT43 accessing multiple public LLM tools but explicitly states that the intended purpose was unclear.

operational_capabilities.name: Access to Public LLM Tools
operational_capabilities.description: GTIG detected APT43 actors accessing multiple publicly available LLM tools. The source did not establish what APT43 intended to do with them.
operational_capabilities.analyst_notes: This is evidence of access, not evidence that AI was used in a specific intrusion or malware workflow.

key_judgments.statement: APT43 had access to multiple public LLM services by the reporting period, but available evidence does not support a specific operational-use claim.

uncertainties.statement: The intended purpose and operational impact of APT43's LLM access remain unknown.
uncertainties.analyst_notes: Do not generalize the report's broader North Korean use cases to APT43 without actor-specific evidence.

assessment.collection_notes: OSINT update: GTIG report dated 2025-01-29, accessed 2026-07-25.

free_text_append.history: 2025年1月、GTIGはAPT43関係者が複数の公開LLMツールへアクセスしていた証拠を報告した。ただし目的は不明であり、特定の攻撃工程での利用を示す情報ではない。
